boundaries.credentialOwner: DSH credentials and pi-ai OAuth; never request, log or export grants
boundaries.transportOwner: DSH llm-pi-ai; no second general Copilot adapter
boundaries.diagnostics: Repository checks only; no live profile, credential, network or model calls
boundaries.attribution: Assisted-by identifies the actual assisting tool; never infer a co-author from a model provider

authorization.purpose: OAuth lifecycle, grant normalization, route projection and account availability
authorization.risk: status and describeGitHubCopilotProviderProfile are read-only; reconcile is an explicit stored-snapshot settings write, not OAuth refresh or capability proof. Opening Models separately calls non-forcing ensureModels once for missing/idle/stale/error/loading signed-in metadata; fresh ready cache needs no request. Explicit successful Start sign-in/account switch forces discovery once. Background credential/reset events clear Client state and read status without forcing discovery on every token event; next open/use ensures metadata. Manual Refresh lives in Manage and errors offer Retry. Configured credentials and discovered metadata do not prove transport readiness.

models.purpose: Automatic account-model freshness with bounded TTL/cooldown, native protocol routing and conservative legacy restoration
models.risk: Default accountModelTtlMs is 86400000 (24h maximum reuse), accountModelFailureCooldownMs is 300000 (5min), configurable under github-copilot. Non-forcing ensureModels on open/use shares one Host flight without periodic metadata polling; the mounted timestamp has a separate display-only 60s timer. Initial ensure includes error (reopen may retry after shared cooldown, no same-mount loops) and loading (join existing Host flight to observe completion, no extra network). Fresh ready does not fetch; true unavailable with empty models does not automatically retry. Same-account last metadata may display during TTL refresh/loading/error but never authorize requests; credential/account/permission invalidation or proof expiry immediately revokes evidence, and TTL never extends tokens. Definitive UNKNOWN_MODEL triggers one bounded metadata refresh without message replay/model switching; generic HTTP/network failures are not classified by guesswork. A same-ID catalog entry can still have the wrong protocol or capabilities. Stay plugin-only: use published APIs or a documented narrow alternative, never a new Core patch/service dependency. Label multiple routes honestly; share the canonical OAuth grant without duplicating general transport. Legacy, interrupted or user-edited ownership journals remain conflicts.

search.purpose: Inline native search and the optional ctx.web provider
search.risk: Registration does not select the global Web provider. Preserve file and reasoning/replay delegation, protocol/account gates and no implicit fallback. Public summaries are not raw reasoning input or decrypted replay. Validate effort against the actual selected model and retain Core default/off semantics.

client.purpose: Provider-integrated account controls, automatic non-forcing metadata ensure, once-per-explicit-sign-in discovery, Manage-only manual Refresh, visible Retry, accessible last-success timestamp and replay-safe reasoning presentation
client.risk: Embed account controls only in a mounted configured canonical github-copilot card; suppress the separate footer controller while embedded and preserve the shared owner across fallback transfer only while another eligible surface remains mounted. Last-surface unmount or nonoverlapping declaration replacement stops polling; a later controller reads status and separately non-forcing ensures missing/idle/stale/error/loading signed-in metadata rather than replaying the old forced-login action. The additive slot cannot replace Core Edit/Delete; normal plugin discovery needs no manual model definition, but the native editor remains. Never merge/remove real github-copilot and github-copilot-preview routes or rewrite credentials/configuration/history/selection for UI integration. Explicit successful Start sign-in/account switch forces one bounded discovery, immediate or polled. Opening Models separately non-forcing ensures missing/idle/stale/error/loading signed-in metadata once; fresh ready cache makes no request. Status/details stay network-free; background credential/reset events clear state and read status, not force every token event. Manual Refresh lives in Manage; errors expose Retry. Alpha.7 displays snapshot.discoveredAt once beside the model count outside Manage: English relative text, full local date/time/zone tooltip and accessible semantic time; absent/invalid/no-account hides it, future timestamps use absolute text. One mounted 60s display-only timer updates the label without RPC/status/discovery and is disposed with the timestamp/unmount. Pending/error keeps last success, successful refresh replaces it and sign-out clears it; cache/discovery lifecycle is unchanged. Use synthetic device codes and message fixtures. Empty reasoning filtering is render-only: never change durable content, encrypted signatures, replay indexes or other providers. Unsupported or conflicting UI registrations retain native rendering. Primary alpha.7 copilot-model-freshness.png and copilot-model-refreshing.png show the built Client in isolated Edge with synthetic Remote/provider shell, not live Core or production auth. Fake-clock browser checks advance 8 to 10 minutes without added RPC, retain timestamps during pending/error, replace them on refresh success, remove timestamp/timer on sign-out and keep 375px layout safe; Host TTL/cooldown timing belongs to unit tests, not screenshots. Provider-entry/authorization PNGs remain historical alpha.5 and older compact-account GIF/PNGs alpha.3. Element-tree tests and historical screenshots do not establish current provider-integrated browser activation.

compatibility.purpose: Supported DSH seams, tool schemas and exact upstream fixture checks
compatibility.risk: Compatibility work is plugin-only. Inspect published Core APIs read-only and verify against unchanged pinned artifacts; historical controlled pins are test evidence, not permission to create another Core patch. Do not modify or publish Core to satisfy this task.

tooling.purpose: Agent contract, preflight, verification, packaging and attribution
tooling.risk: Machine reports must distinguish not checked from failed and never claim live runtime or release success.

release.purpose: Version alignment and immutable GitHub prerelease/release delivery
release.risk: Important updates continue to publication after authorized merge and green required CI without a second release prompt, unless the user restricts delivery. Other changes need an explicit release request. Preserve fresh annotated tags and verified remote assets/checksums; report a concrete blocker instead of calling a merge complete. Profile installation and interrupting restarts remain separate.
